name: Why Did God Ask Abraham to Sacrifice Isaac?

beats.say: An old man climbs a mountain with his son. The son carries the wood.
Wait. God told Abraham to sacrifice his own son? How is that good?
The answer hides in one line.
In Genesis, the Bible's first book, Abraham waited decades for this son.
Isaac asks: where's the lamb? Genesis 22, verse 8:
"And Abraham said, 'My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering.'"

scroll.text: "And Abraham said, 'My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering.'…"

beats.say: "Do not lay your hand on the lad, or do anything to him."

beats.say: A ram dies instead. God never wanted child sacrifice.
The twist? God sent him to Moriah. Jerusalem's temple was later built on Mount Moriah.
John the Baptist sees Jesus. John 1, verse 29:
"Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!"

beats.say: Abraham's son was spared. God's own Son was not.
God did provide the Lamb. His name is Jesus.

post.yt_title: Why Did God Ask Abraham to Sacrifice Isaac? #shorts
post.yt_desc:
"God told Abraham to sacrifice his own son? How is that good?" Read Genesis 22, in the Bible's first book. Abraham, father of the Jewish people, climbs a mountain with Isaac, the son God promised him. Isaac carries the wood and asks where the lamb is: "And Abraham said, 'My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering'" (Genesis 22:8 NKJV).

At the top, God stops him: "Do not lay your hand on the lad, or do anything to him" (Genesis 22:12 NKJV). A ram dies instead. God never wanted child sacrifice and later condemns it outright (Jeremiah 7:31). And the Bible says Jerusalem's temple was later built on Mount Moriah (2 Chronicles 3:1).

Centuries later, John the Baptist sees Jesus: "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!" (John 1:29 NKJV). Abraham's son was spared. God's own Son was not (Romans 8:32). God really did provide the Lamb.

📖 Read it yourself: Genesis 22:1-14 · John 1:29 · Romans 8:32 (NKJV)

post.notes:
- Genesis 22:8 and 22:12 NKJV verified on bible.com v114 (22:12 partial, marked …; 22:8 stops before "So the two of them went together.", marked …). John 1:29 spoken from "Behold!" (verse begins "The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said,").
- Isaac carried the wood (22:6); asked where the lamb was (22:7). Ram caught in a thicket by its horns, offered instead of his son (22:13).
- Abraham waited for Isaac: promise in Gen 12 at age 75 (12:4), Isaac born when Abraham was 100 (21:5) = 25 years ('decades').
- God condemns child sacrifice: Leviticus 18:21, Deuteronomy 12:31, Jeremiah 7:31 (not quoted).
- 2 Chronicles 3:1: Solomon built the house of the LORD at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah (verified). Genesis 22:2 'the land of Moriah'. Script says 'that same name', not that it is proven to be the same peak.
- Romans 8:32 'He who did not spare His own Son, but delivered Him up for us all' (verified, paraphrased outside quotes).
- John the Baptist: a prophet (Luke 7:26), at Bethany beyond the Jordan (John 1:28); script does not place him at Moriah.
- No knife, no violence shown. No depiction of God the Father (scenes: neutral land/temple, Jesus).
